_about: Shared vectors for the bridge condition evaluator (CONDCORE_BUILD_THREE_VALUED_TREES). Run by both src/RimMandrake/Utils/conds.py and JawaBenchCondCore.cs (bridgetools/CondSelfTest); src/RimMandrake/Utils/selftest_conds_vectors.py requires byte-identical outputs and checks each `expect` as a subset of the result. Frame reads carry forward; a key never read is status error. `map` defaults to [250,250], `mapId` to 0.
